Description

The 11-a-side grass football pitch at Sydenham & Dulwich Girls GDST Sports Ground in Beckenham, Greater London, is available to hire for football clubs, teams, schools, leagues and groups. Whether you're looking for a pitch for a one-off match, training session or regular weekly fixtures, the venue offers flexible options for both single and repeat bookings.

The spacious natural grass pitch provides an ideal setting for competitive matches, grassroots football and team training. The venue also has changing rooms available, making it convenient for players before and after games, as well as free on-site parking for teams and visitors.

Located in Beckenham, the ground is easily accessible by public transport, with **Lower Sydenham Station** being the closest train station. With its combination of a full-size 11-a-side grass pitch, changing facilities and free parking, it is a great choice for teams looking for a regular or one-off football venue in South London.
